## BLUEFIN in one page

Finance runs on spreadsheets, and spreadsheet mistakes are expensive. The paper cites an audit of 50 operational spreadsheets that found 117 errors, with impacts of up to $100,000,000. Frontier labs are now shipping spreadsheet assistants, so we need a way to tell whether an AI agent can really do an analyst's workbook job.

**BLUEFIN** is the authors' answer: 131 tasks over professional-finance workbooks, graded by 3,225 granular rubric criteria that experts vetted and an LLM judge applies. The headline result is sobering. Five frontier models all score **below 50%** on the held-out set.

The interesting part is *how* they fail. Models are fairly good at writing formulas that look right, but much worse at producing correct numbers and at building workbooks that keep working when an input changes. This page walks through the problem, the task design, the grading machinery, and what the results show.
